key_points: TD announced a CA$150bn five-year commitment to boost Canadian economy and infrastructure.
WSJ coverage highlights the pledge alongside TD Economics forecast of up to $1.2tn in nation-building capital by 2035.
A separate Globe and Mail report cites a second investor alleging fraudulent trades in an obscure Chinese stock linked to TD.
Motley Fool piece reiterates TD as a top Canadian dividend pick, reinforcing investor confidence.
Overall, the news mix is modestly positive with limited near-term earnings impact.
